metadata.title: SolarEdge Stock Jumps After Upgrade. Why This Analyst Sees a 41% Gain.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
SolarEdge Stock Jumps After Upgrade. Why This Analyst Sees a 41% Gain.
SolarEdge stock rose on Wednesday after the residential solar equipment company was handed a bullish upgrade based on the premise that a federal action last month could unlock 41% upside.
